tools.name: login
tools.description: Log in to Changing Our Futures / MakeChoice with the person's email and password. Returns access_token. Pass that token to score_personality_test. Do not repeat the password.

tools.name: get_personality_questions
tools.description: Fetch the 70-question MakeChoice personality test. Each item has id, question, answer_a, and answer_b. mood is how the person feels right now: ang, plea, love, naug, hap, or sadd.

tools.name: score_personality_test
tools.description: Score the personality test and save it on the logged-in member. access_token comes from login. answers is 70 letters a or b in question order, or objects {id, answer}. A new result can be saved 30 days after the previous one. Returns personality_code, personality_name, characteristics, strengths, we

tools.name: start_donation
tools.description: Start a gift to Changing Our Futures (EIN 47-1878490). Returns a Stripe Checkout url. The person still confirms and pays. amount is whole US dollars. one-time minimum is $1. monthly minimum is $50.

tools.name: list_donors
tools.description: Public donor hall of fame for Changing Our Futures. Returns the newest gifts: name, about, amount, and date.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "login" references sensitive artifacts (password, access_token). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
